schema.title: Response Kb Items V1 Kb Items Get

monthly.title: Monthly
monthly.description: Always null. Per-lender figures are in lenders[]; the range is in monthly_range.

stress_monthly.title: Stress Monthly
stress_monthly.description: Always null. Per-lender figures are in lenders[]; the range is in stress_monthly_range.

applies_when.title: Applies When
applies_when.description: Selection conditions, AND-ed across keys. Key `hazard_layer_intersects: [layer ids]` matches when any listed layer (exact id, any priority) has status `intersects`. It only selects items; it does not state flood history or risk level.

generated_at.title: Generated At
generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in New Zealand time (Pacific/Auckland, e.g. +13:00)

loan_term_years.title: Loan Term Years
loan_term_years.description: Loan term in years used for every repayment figure (30).

rates_stale_after_days.title: Rates Stale After Days
rates_stale_after_days.description: Age in days after which the rates snapshot counts as stale (`rates_snapshot_stale`).

default_rate_pct.title: Default Rate Pct
default_rate_pct.description: Median 1-year standard rate (%) across the banks in the rates snapshot, 2 decimals; null when the snapshot has no such rates. A suggested starting rate for the user.

fhl_income_caps.title: Fhl Income Caps
fhl_income_caps.description: First Home Loan income caps by household (`single`, `multiple_or_dependants`). Always returned, including when `first_home_loan` is not (flag `fhl_income_over_cap`).

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Active flags only. Codes are listed in CODES.md.

hazard_gaps.title: Hazard Gaps
hazard_gaps.description: Primary hazard layers that could not be checked, with the original reason.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Machine-readable warning codes. Codes are listed in CODES.md.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Information only, not financial or legal advice. Figures come from published sources on the dates shown; confirm with the lender or provider before deciding.

decade_range.title: Decade Range
decade_range.description: Inclusive [from, to] decade bounds; a null bound is open-ended. year_built_between matches when this range overlaps the rule's range. An explicit null means mixed eras (no decade).

YearField.title: YearField
YearField.description:
A year, or a decade.

The council records a build decade: `value` is its first year and `decade_range` is
`[from, to]` (inclusive). `year_built_between` matches when `decade_range` overlaps
the rule's range. `[null, 1913]` means 1913 or earlier (no lower bound). An explicit
`decade_range: null` (mixed eras) means no decade is known. Without a `decade_range`
key, `value` (an int year or a string such as "1990s") is used.
